title: Ph.D. in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (International Program) | Bangkok University
link_label: International Program Ph.D. in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (International Program) Ph.D. in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (International Program) Embark on a transformative journey with Bangkok University’s Ph.D. program in Knowledge Management and Innovation Management (Ph.D. KIM). Established in 2011, this research-based program is designed for aspiring researchers, academics, and professionals seeking to explore the role of knowledge and innovation in societal and organizational development. The program accommodates working professionals through fully online learning, with classes scheduled on Saturdays. Students benefit from the guidance of international experts, a global network of professionals, and personalized academic support. Study Plans The program offers two study plans based on applicants’ academic qualifications: Plan 1.1 — For Applicants Holding a Master’s Degree 3 years | 48 credits Plan 1.2 — For Applicants Holding a Bachelor’s Degree 4 years | 72 credits Both plans include preliminary courses in advanced research methodology and seminars on Knowledge Management and Innovation Management, a Qualifying Examination, and dissertation research. Job Opportunities Chief Knowledge OfficerChief Learning OfficerIntellectual Capital DirectorKnowledge Management ExecutiveHuman Resource DirectorInnovation Development DirectorKnowledge Management and Innovation Management Expert For more information and applications: https://phdkim.bu.ac.th Note: Applicants holding a bachelor’s degree who wish to apply for Plan 1.2 must have at least 10 years of professional experience in Knowledge Management or Innovation Management.
